stories.title: "Let’s Watch Influencer Breakup Videos and Pick Sides"
stories.summary: A photo of a YouTube recommendation, The Lucas Lounge beaming with his arms spread between two "We Broke Up" thumbnails on a video called "Let’s Watch Influencer Breakup Videos and Pick Sides", captioned only "LMFAO???". It was the day's most-liked post at 660K, and the top quote post, "glad to see some people are still innovating in the content creation space", got another 330K.
